text:
Anna Chen: Heads-up — audit found we still emit opaque 429s and a few inconsistent 5xx bodies to SDK clients. Proposing we prune the "vernacular" variants and standardize a small canonical set: 429.rate_limit, 429.quota_exceeded, 429.client_error, and map 5xx -> 500.internal / 503.degraded_route. Thoughts?

Miguel Rivera: +1 on narrowing surface area. Do we need both rate_limit and quota_exceeded? sounds close but quota should be non-retryable more often.

Julie Park: For console display we want short, actionable phrasing. Example for 429.rate_limit: "Request rate exceeded — reduce concurrency or use dedicated capacity." Keep it short and link to runbook.

Samir Patel: I'd prefer machine-readable fields alongside the human message: e.g. exposure: {code: "429.rate_limit", retry_after: 12, hint: "reduce_batch"} — SDKs can use those to decide retries, UIs use the human_text.

Anna Chen: Agree on machine fields. Proposal: top-level keys in the body: user_message, code, retry_after (opt), hint_tags (list). Keep the human message scrubbed for PII and legal.

eng-bot: deploy/infra status — error-telemetry-config v2.1 passed CI :white_check_mark:

Miguel Rivera: Two concrete asks for SDK teams: 1) default SDKs should treat 429.rate_limit and 503.degraded_route as retryable with exponential backoff; 2) 429.client_error and 429.quota_exceeded should be surfaced to the developer prominently and not retried automatically.

Julie Park: UX ask: console badges should show user_message and a runbook link. Example badge: "Rate limited — reduce concurrency (Runbook)" and a small tooltip with hint_tags.

Anna Chen: Action items I'm proposing to include in the RFC: - canonical code list and human copy guidelines - SDK mapping table (retryable vs not) - example HTTP header footprint - runbook snippets and console badge templates - telemetry tags to include for dashboards. I'll draft.

Samir Patel: Can we agree on headers as a minimal surface so proxies and CDNs can route? Suggested snippet:
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
X-Redwood-Code: 429.rate_limit
X-Redwood-Hint: reduce_batch
```
This keeps human text optional but gives SDKs stable signals.

Miguel Rivera: Also add telemetry naming: error.kind=rate_limit, route=short_seq, infra_tier=deden (or hosted/dedicated), tenant_id. Make schema forward-compatible.

Julie Park: +1. Also: avoid marketing-y phrasing in the API bodies — keep neutral and prescriptive. Leave welcome message copy for the Console layer only.

Anna Chen: Noted. I'll also run a scan for existing code emissions so we can catch older releases emitting legacy codes and plan a deprecation window.

Miguel Rivera: Reviewers? I'll take SDK retry mapping and telemetry bits.

Julie Park: I'll take console copy and runbook links.

Samir Patel: I'll review header + SDK hints.

Anna Chen: Thanks — I'll post the RFC draft by EOD Friday and add a short sync on Monday. @Miguel @Julie @Samir — tagging you for reviews.

Miguel Rivera: ACK.

Julie Park: ACK :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: ACK, will comment on SDK sections.

Anna Chen: Putting a calendar invite for Monday 10am to finalize runbook phrasing and rollout windows.
